full_judgment:
"66 presumption and determination of age. 

 16. Ongoing to the materials on record it transpires that, on 9-2-1996 the accused committed rape upon Moni Begum daughter of the informant, thereby committed offence prescribed in sections 9(Ga) and 6(3) of the Ain, 1995. The police after investigation submitted charge-sheet accusing them as accused. It is pertinent to point out that, in the trial court the accused produced two certificates showing them as minors and the learned judge relied on such documents without holding any inquiry or taking any evidence to that effect. There are separate procedure for presumption and determination of the age of the accused as laid down in section 66 of the children act 1974.
